event_mapping.note: The team format uses event_id 1. Inside PPOST the same wildfire is identified as "EV-2026-014" (every PPOST record has disaster_id = "EV-2026-014"). This mapping is agreed for these sample files only; it is not a database join. Once Earl's disasters table is connected, PPOST will store the real event id.

data.sample_data_note: Synthetic demonstration data for the fictional Clearwater Ridge Wildfire. Generated from the PPOST seed data and the real PPOST rules engine with a sample set of assessment answers. Not live data, not read from Supabase.
data.field_names: snake_case versions of the app's camelCase fields (e.g. priority_id = priorityId, five_w1h = fiveW1H).
data.layout: Rows = 8 priorities in rank order; columns = recovery sectors. A cell holds the problems with that priority and sector, plus their objective → strategy → tactic chains.

status_values.RED: Unresolved UNKNOWN on a CRITICAL safety item, or a CRITICAL/HIGH problem with no objective
status_values.AMBER: Has problems but at least one PPOST chain is incomplete or a tactic is missing an owner
status_values.GREEN: Every problem has a complete chain down to an owned tactic
status_values.NOT_ASSESSED: No problems recorded for this priority and sector

cost_status_values.RED: At least one tactic in the cell has no cost yet (needs estimate)
cost_status_values.AMBER: All tactics have a cost, but some is still draft (not approved)
cost_status_values.GREEN: All costs finalized (tactic approved and its latest cost approved)

cost_summary_sample.note: SAMPLE values from the PPOST cost history (synthetic), not authoritative financial figures. Totals use each tactic's latest cost entry. Program and by_priority totals count each tactic once, under its primary priority. Cell totals follow the problem chain; in this sample no tactic appears in more than one cell. Authoritative Class D totals belong to the Finance module (Daniel).
